title: The Committee of One Goat
skyStory: A waxing gibbous moon lingers in Capricorn, three quarters full and fully in charge. It has scheduled a meeting with the tides for 4 am and expects everyone to be on time. The North Star has been appointed secretary. Mars arrived late with no agenda, so Saturn handed it a very small chair. The meeting is going extremely well.

reading: You will want to say yes to four new things today. The Capricorn moon puts its sturdy hoof on your foot and says choose. The [[Knight of Wands]] has been reversed in your spread for a reason: the fire works best aimed at one target. Pick the one that makes your chest feel warm, not the one that makes your brain feel clever.

Late in the day, someone thanks you for something you forgot you did. Accept the thanks fully. Do not reply with oh it was nothing. It was something. The Fire Tiger is allowed to purr when complimented. In fact, the universe insists, and it is keeping a little tally of how gracefully you manage it.
joel.mission: Say no to one request today, kindly and clearly, without apologizing more than once.
joel.omen: A single bright red maple leaf on a green lawn. Your one chosen thing is the right one.

reading: Your sign's moon stays one more day, and it has brought a gift basket of quiet confidence. Somebody who usually talks over people will pause and wait for you to finish. You will not even have to raise your voice. You will simply keep talking with your hands until the room gives you the floor.

By evening, the air turns cool and clean, the first night you might want a blanket on your knees. Take it as a sign to slow down. The shore at dusk smells like salt and woodsmoke from somebody's chimney. That chimney might be in a cabin in your imagination. Wave at it.
nancy.mission: Wrap yourself in a blanket for at least one sit this evening and declare the cozy season officially open.
nancy.omen: The smell of woodsmoke on the breeze. Someone far away is thinking of you warmly.

together.text: Declare the cozy season open with a joint ceremony: each of you light a candle or turn on one warm lamp at the same agreed time tonight. Send a photo. The moon will compare the two glows and call it a tie.
